_comment: Fertilizer Maximum Retail Prices (MRP) for the demo economics layer.
_disclaimer: These are representative prices for demonstration purposes. Actual prices vary by region and season.

urea.source: Department of Fertilizers, Government of India — Urea Pricing Policy
urea.note: Statutorily notified MRP, exclusive of neem coating charges and applicable taxes.

dap.source: Department of Fertilizers, Government of India — DAP price stabilisation
dap.note: Government-stabilised MRP maintained through special subsidy packages to insulate farmers from global price volatility.

mop.source: Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme — representative mid-range market price
mop.note: MOP has no single statutory MRP. Under the NBS scheme, retail prices vary by manufacturer and region (approx. ₹900–₹2,200 per 50 kg bag). ₹1,700 is used as a representative mid-range value. THIS IS AN ASSUMPTION — verify against local dealer price for actual advisory.
